item-1790413714606-697774.description:
HyperBat Media is an add-on for Batocera that easily installs system, default or game themes from Bob Morane's HyperBat theme.
Open the showcase from a dedicated entry in the Ports system, or faster with F9, R1 or R3, depending on the choice you made when installing the add-on.
